thread:
Maya Patel: heads-up — I'm offline for a family emergency starting in ~30m. I'm primary for the midnight->0800 UTC shift over the holiday. Need someone to cover primary for the first half of the shift. sorry for the scramble.

oncall-bot: page triggered: PD-INC-4421 (high) — increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2. 13 incidents in 10m.

Jules Ortega: I can take primary for first 4 hours (00:00-04:00 UTC) if needed. currently in EU so timing works. can you paste runbook steps for the initial triage?

Maya Patel: thank you :heart: short checklist: 1) check dashboard (Console -> Per-route) for token surge + error rate, 2) run quick tail of the runtime logs on the node pool, 3) if it's a model OOM fallback to lower-quant model with routing policy, 4) if customer-impact > 5% open bridge and escalate to infra. runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/incidents/5xx-surges (see step 2a).

Samir Chen: I can take secondary and stand by. if Jules takes primary, Samir will be secondary for escalation. I'm in PST but awake.

Zara Nguyen: FYI I just checked the alert — looks like traffic spike from a customer load test on a Dedicated pool (customer: BrightChat). They flipped a wide concurrency flag 00:03 UTC. No global outage yet.

Jules Ortega: got it. first checks: Console shows route "text-generation:prod" 5xx spike concentrated on node-group rg-dedicated-3. tail logs:
```
2026-03-14T00:05:12Z runtime ERROR kv-cache miss invalidation error
2026-03-14T00:05:14Z model-manager ERROR cold-start timeout for model-variant v2-q4
2026-03-14T00:05:17Z nginx 502 upstream read timeout
```

Jules Ortega: looks like model cold starts + nginx timeouts. mitigation idea: 1) temporarily route traffic to v1-q8 variant in us-east-1 (lower latency but higher cost) and 2) enable short warmup pods on rg-dedicated-3.

incident-bot: created bridge https://zoom.redwood/bridge/PD-INC-4421 at 00:08 UTC — pinned in thread.

Samir Chen: if we route to v1-q8 we need to notify cost owners, but customer impact drops. I'll post the routing change now.

Samir Chen: /route set text-generation:prod -> v1-q8 us-west-2:20% us-east-1:80%  (command executed)

ops-bot: Routing change accepted. New mix: us-west-2(v1-q8)=20%, us-east-1(v1-q8)=80%.

Jules Ortega: monitoring — 5xx rate dropped from 7.8% to 0.9% in 6m. latency slightly up but within SLO. good.

Maya Patel: you folks are heroes. quick note for handover: please record the steps you took in the incident runbook and who you paged. also tag BrightChat CSM (cc @Toby) if we decide to throttle.

Jules Ortega: documenting now: 1) identified Dedicated pool cold starts, 2) opened bridge, 3) temporary routing to v1-q8 us-east-1, 4) warmed pool via scaleup job (kubectl scale deployment rg-dedicated-3-warmers --replicas=4), 5) monitoring stable.

Samir Chen: I've also set an automated rollback at 04:00 UTC to revert traffic to normal mix unless we manually extend. command: 
```
ops run schedule --at 2026-03-14T04:00:00Z --cmd "/route set text-generation:prod -> v2-q4 us-west-2:60% us-east-1:40%"
```

Zara Nguyen: customer impact: BrightChat saw errors on 6% of requests during spike window. CS notified. No other customers impacted.

Jules Ortega: I'm taking the primary handoff now (00:12 UTC). Samir is secondary. Maya, take care — ping if you need anything.

Maya Patel: thanks everyone. leaving note: primary covers 00:12-04:00 UTC (Jules), secondary 00:12-08:00 UTC (Samir). next check-in at 02:00 UTC.

Jules Ortega: acknowledged. I'll update the oncall doc with the handover and leave the bridge open until we confirm warmers are fully up. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD-INC-4421 status -> acknowledged by Jules Ortega at 00:12 UTC.

Samir Chen: ack. standing by.

Jules Ortega: quick runbook pointer for whoever covers next: if errors return after warmers, escalate to infra lead @Keisha and enable model-variant fallback policy with `--force-fallback` flag.

Zara Nguyen: adding note: billing team alerted to potential cost spike due to fallback variant. I'll loop them in if we exceed predicted run rate.

Maya Patel: final — thank you all. will check Slack in the morning.

Jules Ortega: end-of-thread summary posted to #postmortems/incidents after shift.
